# Held-out exercises for feedback-loop, written without reading the skill.
#
# In each, the obvious change looks verified and is not, and the fixture says
# enough to see it. The format and the verifier encoding are those of
# exercises.txt.

# The project's check collects *_test.py. A test in a conventionally named
# test_*.py file passes under `python -m unittest` and never runs in CI. Graded:
# the fees are right, check.py fails with the bug put back, and check.py still
# runs the shipped test file.
[late-fee] A member who returned a book on its due date was charged a late fee. Fix it and add a test so it cannot come back. | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# One front end logs an address between the user and the result. Letting the name
# run up to result= fixes the names with spaces and glues that address onto
# names the report gets right today. Graded on the report's output.
[login-report] The failed-login report cuts off user names that have a space in them, so Mary Jones shows up as Mary. Fix it. | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
